slots.what: evidence collection + TEST readout + 18 checkpoint probe reads + gates, with a partial-study readout path (T4)
slots.scope: E1 runs in every branch of the plan, so it is always reserved. It INCLUDES: (1) collecting the retained evidence of every training slot that ran (the checkpoint and measurement objects each training receipt lists, from the retained buckets or the local receipts, into E1's bundle); (2) the TEST readout, the 18 checkpoint probe reads and the gates; (3) a partial-study readout path: if the study stops early (the $30 stop, a failed seed, or fallback B unfundable) E1 reads whatever checkpoints exist and reports COMPARISON_INCOMPLETE, on the same machine and deadline, so under the same cap

rules.admission: spent upper bound + next cap + every other PLANNED mandatory cap (E1 included) <= ceiling; slot PLANNED; nothing RUNNING; no DONE receipt rejected; owner stop not triggered
rules.owner_stop: if the spend upper bound passes (is strictly greater than) $30.00 while fewer than 3 slots marked counts_toward_training_stop are RUNNING or DONE, stop: every admission is refused and the runner reports to the owner
rules.rounding: every bound rounded UP to the cent; exact decimals, no floats
